name: TXR Robotics Co Ltd.
summary: Operating as a South Korean firm previously named TaeSung System Co., Ltd., TXR Robotics Co., Ltd. is dedicated to furnishing state-of-the-art logistics and robotic automation solutions. The company's activities are structured into two core business units: Logistics Automation and Robot Automation. Its Logistics Automation division provides a range of specialized sorting machinery, including wheel, flap, and tilt tray models, alongside comprehensive support services such as equipment upkeep and property leasing. Conversely, the Robot Automation division is responsible for creating and supplying advanced robotic technologies. This portfolio encompasses autonomous mobile robots (AMRs), automatic guided vehicles (AGVs), mobile manipulators, AMR control systems (ACSs), and multi-joint robots, additionally offering factory automation services and robotic equipment hire.
